data.description:
Create 3 contract markdown files satisfying the RED tests from T1.

Files to create:
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/decision-id-format.md
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-envelope.md
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/meta-question-signal.md

decision-id-format.md required content:
- Format: <session_id>:<content_hash>
- session_id sourcing chain: harness file -> DSO_SESSION_ID env -> pv-session-<timestamp_ms>
- content_hash: SHA-256 of the decision text (first 16 hex chars)
- Required sections: ## Signal Name, ## Status, ## Scope, ## Date, ## Format, ## Emitter, ## Parser, ## Examples

inference-envelope.md required content:
- INFERENCE_CHALLENGE fields: decision_id, challenge_type, evidence_against_inference, user_confirmation_required (bool)
- INFERENCE_SKIP fields: reason, hash_bucket
- Required sections: ## Signal Name, ## Status, ## Format, ## Emitter, ## Parser

meta-question-signal.md required content:
- META_QUESTION signal; blocking_for field; instruction: do NOT REPLAN_ESCALATE
- Required sections: ## Signal Name, ## Status, ## Format, ## Emitter, ## Parser

Each file starts with '# Contract: <name>' header per project convention.

AC: T1 test functions for these 3 files pass. RED markers for these 3 source files removed from .test-index. No ruff checks (no Python files modified).
